properties.name: excel.enabled
properties.description: Whether the Excel auto-configuration is enabled.

properties.name: excel.default-sheet-name
properties.description: Default sheet name used when writing if no explicit name is supplied.

properties.name: excel.charset
properties.description: Charset used for download headers and CSV handling.

properties.name: excel.batch-size
properties.description: Batch size used by the batch read listener when streaming large files.

properties.name: excel.auto-close-stream
properties.description: Whether EasyExcel should automatically close the underlying stream after a read/write operation.

properties.name: excel.head-row-number
properties.description: Number of header rows to skip when reading.

properties.name: excel.excel-type
properties.description: Default file type used when writing (XLSX, XLS or CSV).
